items.reason: The lower 2.5% strength is a gentler rinse-off wash for the breakout-prone look you described, and it stays on the skin only briefly.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps offset dryness from the wash and supports comfortable, balanced-looking skin.
A mineral SPF 50 protects daily and suits skin that is trying to stay even-toned.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day in the evening at first, then moisturizer, and apply the SPF every morning. Since you are trying for a baby, please check any active ingredients with your doctor or midwife, and I have left out retinoids and strong peels on purpose.
